title: NEW: verify_application_in_vacancy's DB Error arm still rides the 404 catch-all — the N10 fix covered only the sibling vacancy-active check
detail: The r4 N10 fix gave verify_vacancy_active's Error arm a db_failure 500, but the first precheck's Error arm still falls into the shared catch-all and returns 404 'Application not found' — a DB outage during the app↔vacancy check is mislabeled as a missing application. Fail-closed (the action never runs) but the error class is masked.
recommended_fix: Add an explicit Error(err) arm to the verify_application_in_vacancy case calling db_failure, mirroring the vacancy-active check's arm at line 647.
